note: Work: the Labour Code (Ley 185 of 1996), article 131 as replaced by Ley 474 (La Gaceta No. 199 of 21 October 2003): the minimum age to work for pay is 14, and work below it is prohibited; adolescents may sign employment contracts themselves from sixteen. The text makes no exception for performers, so the form holds them barred below 14 (my reading). Later reforms of article 131 weren't checked. Read from the Enrique Bolaños Foundation's digital copy of La Gaceta (the National Assembly's legislation site refused this client with 403). Majority: the Family Code (Ley 870 of 2014) is on Justia only as a summary page, with no text found; left null. Service: no law on military service was found; left null.

sources.title: La Gaceta, Diario Oficial No. 199 of 21 October 2003 (Ley 474), copy held by the Enrique Bolaños Foundation
sources.said: “Arto. 131. La edad mínima para trabajar mediante remuneración laboral es de 14 años, en consecuencia se prohíbe el trabajo a menores de esa edad.
